<thought>Two carbon NMR signals fall in the aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm): 135.80 ppm and 117.40 ppm. This pattern is typical for a para‑disubstituted benzene ring, which contains six aromatic carbons that give rise to two distinct signals. Therefore, the molecule has six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
